bounded_slice.question: At the pinned rust-sdk commit, can a server handler observe a modern stateless request's _meta.io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities independently of Peer::peer_info?
bounded_slice.observation: Yes at the source-path level. model/meta.rs states that wire params._meta is deserialized into envelope Extensions and the service loop moves it into RequestContext::meta before dispatch. RequestMetaObject is a transparent arbitrary metadata map and explicitly reserves io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities. handler/server/common.rs exposes a FromContextPart extractor for RequestMetaObject that swaps the handler's RequestContext.meta into the extracted RequestMetaObject. Therefore a handler that accepts RequestMetaObject/RequestContext can inspect the original request metadata independently of peer_info; the peer_info_for_stateless_request defaults observed in worker236 do not erase the separate RequestContext.meta path.
